component.name: config-deploy
component.description: Write named config files on a ctrl-exec agent from contents sent by the dispatcher, within an agent-side map of allowed files

components.name: agent-config-deploy
components.description: Agent script (Perl): writes the file its config-deploy.conf maps the caller's name to, validated, with the old file kept as .prev

components.name: install.sh
components.description: Installer (bash): puts the script, the map example and the scripts.conf entry in place without overwriting host config; --dry-run reports only

components.name: config-push
components.description: Dispatcher-side run-jobs job: pushes local source files to named config entries on agents, or checks them with --check

components.name: perl-base
components.description: Core modules only: JSON::PP, Digest::SHA, POSIX, Cwd, Encode, File::Basename, Fcntl, IO::Handle, Sys::Hostname, Time::HiRes

components.name: bash
components.description: GNU Bourne Again shell, for install.sh and the run-jobs job

components.name: bsdutils
components.description: Provides logger(1) for the run-jobs job
